Class ProductClient

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
com.robuschi.ProductClient
public class ProductClient extends javafx.application.Application

The ProductClient class is the main client application for the online product sales system.

Manages the JavaFX application lifecycle and view navigation.

Author:
Mattia Robuschi Caprara

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start(javafx.stage.Stage primaryStage)

      This method starts the JavaFX application.

      It is called by the init() method which is inherited from the Application class, which sets the primaryStage.

      The method sets the title for the window, it tries to connect to the server, and if the connection is successful it sets the message handler and shows the login view.

      Specified by:
      start in class javafx.application.Application
      Parameters:
      primaryStage - is the primary stage of the application

    • showLoginView

      private void showLoginView()

      This method shows the login view.

      It loads the login.fxml FXML file from the resources, it sets the scene and sets the style of the view.

      Gets called in the start() method.

    • showMainView

      private void showMainView()

      This method shows the main application view.

      It loads the main.fxml FXML file from the resources, it sets the scene, sets the username visible on the main view and sets the style of the view.

      Gets called if the authentication attempt is successful.

      See Also:
      • MainController

    • handleServerMessage

      private void handleServerMessage(Protocol.Message message)

      This method handles all the incoming messages from the server.

      • If the received message has type AUTH_SUCCESS the method sets the username and then launches the main view using showMainView()
      • If the received message has type AUTH_FAILED the method shows a dialog displaying the error "Authentication failed. Invalid credentials."
      • If the received message has type PRODUCT_LIST the method launches the function mainController.updateAvailableProducts(productList.getProducts()) to update the product list
      • If the received message has type PRODUCT_PURCHASED the method add the purchased product into the user's product list and then sends a message of type GET_PRODUCTS to the server
      • If the received message has type RETURN_ACCEPTED the method removes the purchased product from the user's product list and then sends a message of type GET_PRODUCTS to the server
      • If the received message has type SERVER_CLOSE the method displays a dialog stating "Server is closing" and then launches the Platform.exit() method
      • If the received message has type ERROR the method shows an error dialog that displays the given error
      Parameters:
      message - the received message
      See Also:
      • Protocol.MessageType

    • logout

      public void logout()

      This method logs out and closes the application.

      It sends a message of type USER_LOGOUT to the server, prints a goodbye message and then calls the Platform.exit() method.

    • stop

      public void stop()

      This method stops the application.

      It is called when the method Platform.exit() is called.

      It checks if the network manager is null, if not the method networkManager.disconnect() is called.

      Overrides:
      stop in class javafx.application.Application

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)

      Main method to launch the application.

      It uses the launch(args) method to launch the default constructor of the class (which in this case is implicit).

      Then, the default constructor launches the init() method which is inherited from the Application class.

      The init() method launches the start() method which then actually starts the application.

      Parameters:
      args - command line arguments
